title: linux: routine op — Rafforza sshd (solo chiavi, no root login) mantenend
scenario: On linux, perform a single well-defined operational change: rafforza sshd (solo chiavi, no root login) mantenendo l'accesso corrente. The change must be correct, minimal, and persistent.
initial_state: # fixture: baseline host ready for op 'harden_ssh'
expected_reasoning: Step: keep a working session open.
Step: validate config and reload safely.
Confirm the desired end-state explicitly rather than assuming success.
expected_commands: # os-appropriate command sequence for 'harden_ssh' on linux
safety_constraints: Make only the requested change; avoid scope creep.
The change must persist across reboot where applicable.
Do not weaken security posture to complete the op.
success_criteria: The requested end-state holds and persists; no unrelated state was changed.
failure_criteria: End-state not achieved, non-persistent, or achieved by an over-broad/insecure change.
recovery_strategy: Single, reversible change; capture prior state so it can be undone.
possible_mistakes: Enable-for-boot but forget to start now (or vice versa).
Apply the change at runtime only, losing it on reboot.
Over-broaden the change (open all ports, 777, etc.).
hints: enable != start; add != activate — confirm BOTH where relevant.
Prefer stable identifiers (UUID, service name) over volatile ones.
reference_solution: Perform 'harden_ssh' with the minimal correct command set
alternative_solution: Express the change declaratively (unit/config/manifest) instead of imperatively.
edge_cases: A runtime-only change looks successful until the next reboot.
The persistent config location differs from the runtime one.
goal: Rafforza sshd (solo chiavi, no root login) mantenendo l'accesso corrente
